'''''Half a Star''''' was a transport owned by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]]. It was one of the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] used in the [[Mission to save Kessel|attempt to save]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] from destruction in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]].
